name: Shinkai no Hobby Gel
source:
When "Midori" woke up, she was in the rainy "Kujira no Machi". She remembered nothing but her own name. She embarks on a journey to search for memories with Aoi, the girl who found her...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6893]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
“Midori”醒来时，发现自己身处下雨的“Kujira no Machi”。她除了自己的名字，什么也不记得。她与发现自己的女孩Aoi一起踏上旅程，寻找失去的记忆……

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6893]NovelGame[/url]]
